events.detail: Primary goal B accepted for the astronaut, with return to base A.
Planning route A to B and back.
Route r1 published on map v1 (orbital CTX map only). The corridor is still uncertain.
Astronaut departs from base A on route r1.
Route r1 crosses cells with sigma 3 m. Drone reconnaissance requested.
Drone flies over the corridor.
Observation obs-001 covers 996 cells across the corridor.
Map v2: drone saw a scarp across the corridor with local slope up to 54° (illustrative human limit 20°).
Inspection candidate C: real Curiosity science site Buckskin (drill hole, sol 1060).
Inspection candidate D: real Curiosity science site Big Sky (drill hole, sol 1119).
Route r1 crosses the scarp seen in map v2 (slope above 20°). Astronaut halted at the current position.
Replanning from the astronaut position.
Route r2 goes around the scarp. Round trip -64 s versus r1, still within budget.
Astronaut resumes on route r2.
Rover round trip to C needs about 1215 Wh, within the usable 1520 Wh (20 % reserve kept).
Rover round trip to D needs about 1833 Wh around the scarp, above the usable 1520 Wh (20 % reserve kept). Not assigned.
Rover inspecting Buckskin.
Inspection of Buckskin complete (simulated). Sampling not requested in this run.
Astronaut reached goal B and starts the science task.
Primary goal B completed.
Returning to base A on the return leg of r2.
Astronaut back at base A. Goal completed, return verified under the model, no budget violation.

Photo tour: the rover will visit all 166 real Curiosity stops of this map (sol 751 to 4462), in the order NASA's rover visited them. Illustrative speed; resource use is not modelled during the tour. 3 stops at the crop edge are visited from 20 m inside it.
Rover leaves base for the first real stop.
Rover visited all 166 real stops.
